svg.title: Match the conclusion to the measured biological level
svg.desc: A four-level evidence map proceeds from a confirmed oriented sequence change to RNA/protein effects,cell behaviour and a broader biological outcome. Each transition needs evidence rather than an automatic causal arrow: matched processing and activity measurements,reference and perturbation controls,and testing in the relevant setting with alternative causes. Recurrence of a tumour variant is a research lead,not unique causal proof or an individual diagnosis. Mutagen comparisons must specify dose,route,duration,system and detection method. No empirical counts,exposure results or treatment conclusion are fabricated.

g.text: Match the conclusion to the measured biological level
Sequence changes do not automatically establish functional or broader outcomes.
Evidence needed before the next claim
Identify oriented positions; confirm the measurement.
Use matched controls and a targeted perturbation.
Test the relevant biological setting and competing causes.
A recurrent tumour variant is a lead, not proof of its cause or a diagnosis of an individual.
For mutagen comparisons, retain dose, route, duration, system and detection method; no outcomes invented.
